text:
Maya: Quick check-in on the Private deploy cutover playbook. Need field & infra signoff before we slot this into the H2 roadmap.
Rohit: High level: we plan two upgrade modes: in-place operator patch (for online VPC) and offline bundle (for air-gapped). Need measurable launch criteria.
Lena: Customers want predictable egress IPs + a clear rollback path. Also asking for a pre-cutover dry-run option.
Omar: NetOps note: we can offer a sticky-egress mapping for Dedicated VPCs (customers maintain same SNAT) but it requires static NAT allocations and a brief maintenance window to swap routes.
Riley: For on-prem offline installs we should add a "session-affinity warmup" step: spin secondary nodes with warmed caches before traffic shift. That reduces cold-kv misses.
DeployBot: Deploy template created: runbook.v1/boot -> runbook.v1/cutover -> runbook.v1/verify
Maya: Proposed acceptance criteria (draft):
- VPC Online lane: p99 latency regression <= 12%, token-error-rate delta <= 0.05% during 1h canary
- Airgap lane: documented restart max 6m; customer signoff required for >3m
- Rollback: ability to revert to previous operator within 20m from trigger
Rohit: Implementation constraints: operator quiesce must flush in-flight requests to disk and emit snapshot; resume path must rehydrate KV in <4m for acceptable UX.
Lena: Field checklist we need: customer contact, maintenance window, NAT allocation, DNS TTL plan, runbook preview link. Also need a standard template email for customers.
Omar: DNS plan: drop TTL to 60s 24h before cutover, then to 15s 30m before. For BGP peers we schedule a route swap with a 5m hold.
Riley: QA: we will run 1k synthetic prompts, traffic pattern mix (chat + embeddings). Success gate: <5 end-to-end truncation incidents and no duplicate-token billing events.
SalesLead: Commercial ask: some enterprise customers require an explicit clause guaranteeing egress IP immutability for the duration of a rollout. We should list this as a paid add-on.
Maya: Roadmap implication: add a "Dedicated egress pinning" tickbox in the ordering flow and a contract template bullet.
Rohit: Risk: on older hardware snapshot+rehydration may push node CPU to 95% and degrade serving. Mitigation: stagger node warmups and use a low-priority background rehydrate.
Lena: Rollback triggers (field suggestion): if p95 latency > SLA + 40% for 15m OR token-error-rate > 0.1% for 10m -> rollback.
DeployBot: Runbook excerpt:
```
- preflight: verify nat_allocated, dns_ttl=60
- warm: start warmers on subset nodes (10%) for 10m
- canary: 2% traffic -> new bundle, monitor 30m
- ramp: 2% -> 20% -> 60% -> 100% with 15m holds
- rollback: set rollout_state=rollback; disable new route announcements
```
Maya: Action items: Rohit to spec snapshot/replay API + perf budget (due Tue). Omar to produce NAT allocation guide and BGP playbook (due Wed). Lena & Riley to author runbook + customer email template (due Thu). I'll own contract wording with Sales.
SalesLead: We'll tag customers in CRM who need egress-pin and prioritize pre-sales engineering.
Rohit: I'll also add telemetry flags to emit "cutover-phase" metrics so we can slice perf by phase.
Maya: Thanks all. If no objections I'll promote this into the public roadmap next Monday. :party_popper:
